heroes.name: Roadhog
heroes.summary: Increased Chain Hook frequency enhances his pick potential and overall ability to control space.

changes.note: Cooldown reduced from 8 to 7 seconds.

heroes.name: Sombra
heroes.summary: Improved retention of movement speed when damaged allows for more successful escapes and agile repositioning.

changes.note: Movement speed bonus reduction while revealed by damage reduced from 50% to 33%.

heroes.name: Vendetta
heroes.summary: A higher health pool significantly increases survivability and alters lethal break-points for opponents.

changes.note: Health increased from 175 to 200. (Total health increased from 250 to 275.)

heroes.name: Mizuki
heroes.summary: Removing the ability for enemies to block the recall point ensures the mechanic functions reliably as an escape tool.

changes.note: Enemies can no longer prevent Mizuki from recalling by standing on Katashiro Return's starting point.

heroes.name: Hazard
heroes.summary: Sweeping nerfs to damage and resource generation severely cripple Hazard's frontline sustainability and offensive pressure.

changes.note: Damage decreased from 60 to 40.
Extra [Spike Guard] Resource reduced from 30% to 15%.
[Violent Leap] Hit Bonus Energy decreased from 15% to 10%.
Movement Speed penalty reduction decreased from 90% reduced to 50% reduced.
Extra [Spike Guard] Resource bonus decreased from 50% to 25%.
[Jagged Wall] Hits Bonus Energy decreased from 25% to 15%.

heroes.name: Junker Queen
heroes.summary: Reducing wound damage lowers her self-healing and overall pressure during brawls.

changes.note: Wound damage decreased from 40 to 25.

heroes.name: Orisa
heroes.summary: Significant hits to sustain and damage output force Orisa into a much less dominant and more punishable position.

changes.note: Healing reduced from 8% of Max Life per second to 5% of Max Life per second.
Bonus damage decreased from 25% to 10%.
Attack Speed stat bonus decreased from 10% to 5%.
Cost increased from 4000 to 5000.

heroes.name: Ramattra
heroes.summary: Trading defensive sustain for higher damage amplification and utility shifts him toward a more glass-cannon style of engagement.

changes.note: Maximum damage increased to 150.
[Annihilation] Duration bonus decreased from 2s to 1s.
Healing decreased from 50% to 25% of damage mitigated.
[Nemesis Form] Cooldown Reduction per enemy hit by [Ravenous Vortex] reduced from 1s to 0.5s.
Void Blight damage increased from 20 to 30.
Cost decreased from 12000 to 10000.
Damage amplification increased from 10% to 15%.
[Ravenous Vortex] cooldown reduction reduced from 100% to 75%.
Final Form healing reduced from 80 to 50.
Re-enabled.

heroes.name: Zarya
heroes.summary: Improved currency generation provides faster scaling and item progression in applicable game modes.

changes.note: Increased currency earned from Healing and Damage by 7.14%.

heroes.name: Freja
heroes.summary: Lowering the efficiency of her additional bolts reduces her burst damage and multi-target lethality.

changes.note: Additional bolt damage decreased from 50% reduced damage to 60% reduced damage.

heroes.name: Ana
heroes.summary: Re-enabling the Cluster Core restores previous functionality without impacting baseline competitive stats.

changes.note: Re-enabled.

heroes.name: Brigitte
heroes.summary: A significant reduction in Repair Pack duration decreases her ability to provide sustained support to mobile flankers.

changes.note: [Repair Pack] Duration bonus decreased from 50% to 25%.

heroes.name: Juno
heroes.summary: Higher critical damage and improved falloff range greatly increase her threat level at distance.

changes.note: Critical damage increased from 175% to 200%.
[Mediblaster] Falloff range bonus increased from 5m to 15m.
Re-enabled.

heroes.name: Wuyang
heroes.summary: Major cuts to Overhealth mechanics and increased costs significantly lower Wuyang's utility as a support.

changes.note: Passive [Restoration Stream] Duration bonus reduced from 50% to 25%.
Overhealth per second reduced from 10 to 5.
Max Overhealth decreased from 30 to 15.
Cost increased from 4000 to 5000.
